name: Isometric
description: Isometric is the agentic certification platform for the industrial economy. Its AI agents work alongside human verifiers, reviewing every data point so expert judgment is freed for the calls that matter. From carbon removal and superpollutant reduction to low-carbon energy, fuels, and materials, Isometric brings them all onto a single platform.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Isometric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Isometric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.isometric.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Isometric MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Isometric lists 13 MCP tools, including how_to, isometric_docs_get, isometric_docs_list, me, openapi_documents_get_object, openapi_documents_list_objects, protocols_analyze, protocols_get_content, protocols_get_metadata, protocols_list, skills_get, and skills_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Isometric?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Isometric in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
Isometric requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Isometric is developed by Isometric HQ Ltd. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
